config.temperature: not sent in any arm (provider default); /api/v1/chat has no temperature parameter

arms.A: full history every turn, direct AI Gateway call, no memory layer
arms.B: belcore https://belcore.xyz/api/v1/chat, stateless (no emotion, no endUserId), full history sent, engine trims
arms.C: last 10 turns (20 messages) + current message, direct AI Gateway call

config.recallProbe: each question sent once after turn N, appended to the arm's context, not added to history
config.belcoreKey: env BELCORE_BENCH_API_KEY (value never logged or stored)
